previous_statement: If T is nonvanishing, def-compressed-corner says that S_T with compressed product has unit u_T=Co_T(T) and is an O(delta+epsilon)-C*-algebra. The defining unit-norm axiom of an eta-C*-algebra is abs(||I||-1)<=eta; unpacking the universal O(delta+epsilon) constant therefore gives universal b<infinity and a universal validity threshold such that abs(||u_T||-1)<=b*(delta+epsilon). This proves item (iii).
new_statement: Assume the bounds in nodes 1.1.1 and 1.1.2, and let T be nonvanishing. Then, after imposing e=delta+epsilon<=1, one has ||T||<=1+a*e and ||u_T-T||<=[k*(1+a)+2*(1+a)+1]*e. Hence the reverse triangle inequality and the nonvanishing bound give abs(||u_T||-1)<=[a+k*(1+a)+2*(1+a)+1]*e. This proves item (iii) without invoking any unregistered unit-normalization axiom for an eta-C*-algebra.
